name: Retro Vault Elite Short Ad
voiceoverScript: Still juggling spreadsheets and collector apps that miss half your stuff?
Retro Vault Elite lets you track what you own, what you want, and the oddball titles other databases skip.
It is early, collector-first, and getting better from real community feedback.

scenes.caption: Retro Vault Elite is built around the way collectors actually browse and track games.
Search fast, open details, and build a wanted list without leaving the vault.
Custom entries and trade beta work are being built from community feedback.
